tex_content.html:
There is a universal $\varepsilon _0>0$ such that if $\varepsilon \leq \varepsilon _0$, then for every open $U\subset B(x,T,r)$ and $0\leq \tau _1\leq \tau _0$, \[ 0.9\leq \frac{\Vol _{g(T)}U}{\Vol _{g(T-\tau _1)}U} \leq 1.1. \] \end{claim}

Proof

\sketch ↗ claim:scalar-curvature-gradient-metric-bound The metric comparison in Claim 2 gives the corresponding determinant and volume-form bounds; decrease $\varepsilon _0$ until these lie in $[0.9,1.1]$.

□
